sources.title: New Hart’s Rules: The Oxford Style Guide
sources.author: Anne Waddingham, editor; Oxford University Press
sources.accessScope: Title/copyright pages, preface, contents, and beginning of chapter 1 inspected in an OUP-origin preview. Most operational rules and the complete book were not read.
sources.rights: OUP copyright 2005/2014; all rights reserved. No preview, book text, dictionary, or reproduced checklist bundled.

rules.intent: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.
rules.rationale: Shared project meaning-preservation requirement; style never authorizes factual change.

rules.intent: Identify the edition and editorial scope; record explicit house-style decisions and conflicts.
rules.rationale: Source-assisted workflow designed by this project; the preview establishes edition identity, not a complete operational method.

rules.intent: Apply an attributed book rule only after reading its relevant passage, including qualifications; otherwise mark it unverified.
rules.rationale: Prevents presenting familiar UK editorial habits as verified New Hart’s Rules.
exceptions: Ask for a lawful relevant excerpt or access only when the missing rule changes the requested edit.

rules.intent: Apply a verified editorial decision consistently to editable prose while preserving quotations, code, citations, and intentional exceptions.
rules.rationale: Project editing workflow, not a claim that a book-wide checklist was inspected.
exceptions: An explicit user/house-style override takes precedence and must not be described as the book rule.

rules.intent: Separate verified source-based changes, user house-style choices, and unresolved questions in an optional audit.
rules.rationale: Original project provenance reporting for source-limited editorial work.
